sections.title: MUSA Summer: Introduction to GIS & Statistics
sections.description: The summer GIS Bootcamp prepare students for the intermediate GIS classes that begin in the fall semester. It begins with a discussion of GIS in planning and the social sciences and then moves on to topics related to spatial data, geocoding, projection, vector and raster-based geoprocessing, 3D visualization and more. Each class includes a brief lecture and a walk through involving actual planning related data.
